meta.description: Hangs thin gills under a cap where a pattern has stripes, like Agaricus: every stripe of reaction_diffusion becomes a plate that forks and starts between others where the stripes do. Free of the stipe, or with decurrent running on down it like Pleurotus. For the blunt false gills of a chanterelle use ridges. Gives the gills as a mesh, which keeps the plates thin at any mesh resolution.

cap.description: The paths of the cap node: the rays of the caps and their stipes. The gills hang from the underside of the rays and follow them when they move.

pattern.description: Stripes around the axis, every stripe becomes a gill. Its radius is the distance along the cap underside from the axis.

depth.description: How far the gills reach down from the cap underside. Read along the gill, alpha 0 at the stipe to 1 at the margin, so a curve shapes it, and for every stipe, so it can follow the size of each mushroom.

free_distance.description: Gap between the gills and the stipe, Agaricus gills are free

decurrent.description: How far the gills that reach the stipe run on down it, lower and lower until they are gone. Needs a free distance of 0. Read for every stipe.

thickness.description: Thickness of a gill where it leaves the cap, it thins to half at the edge. Read for every stipe.

edge_wave.description: How much the gill edges wave, sideways and up and down. 0 = straight edges, 1 = waves a third of the gill spacing wide
